purpose: Empty-hand idle poses and first frames for greeting animations

sprites.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent idle sprite and first frame for a desktop tea timer greeting animation. Edit target: the LEFTMOST character in the provided three-state atlas. Produce exactly ONE full-body character, not an atlas. Preserve the exact face, eye color, hair, costume, ornament details, head-to-body proportions, and delicate anime linework of that leftmost character. Remove the teacup completely. Her two empty hands rest naturally just in front of her waist with palms relaxed and slightly separated, elbows down. Both eyes open, gentle small closed-mouth smile, feet planted in the same stance. No waving yet; this is the neutral beginning and ending pose for a later wave animation. Absolutely no cup, saucer, teapot, food, floating objects, extra arms or extra fingers. Entire hair, shoes, accessories and tail visible, about 85 percent of the image height with generous transparent margin on all sides. Centered, square canvas, genuine transparent alpha background, no text or watermark. Keep character identity and costume unchanged; change only removal of cup and natural empty-hand pose. This is the blue-haired whale maid, with blue eyes, navy-and-white frilled dress, small whale head ornament, blue whale tail.
